spec_match.rationale: The paint surface is a float16 context requesting toneMapping 'extended'. Strokes write values up to 8x white, and the explainer's serialization rule is checked by encoding with toBlob and decoding into a float16 canvas.

interactive.rationale: Pointer painting, keyboard cursor with Space/Enter stamping, brightness and size sliders, sample/clear buttons, and export with readback and a thumbnail.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Painting, inspection and the export clipping check all match the card.

edge_cases.rationale: Labels the fallback (displayed clipped), reports 'unknown' when float readback is missing, and shows file clipping (decoded max 1.000 in 153) as the gap that HLG/PQ encoding addresses.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, the explainer's serialization section and hdr-big-picture.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless (Playwright), default and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: every button, select and range exercised, console/pageerror/failed-request clean, 0px overflow. A stamp at 4x stored red 1.724 with an 8-bit view of 255. A 29.6 KiB PNG export decoded to max 1.000, so it was clipped. The extended display path has not been observed.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts context creation, that stamps store values above 1 when brightness is above 1, and the export round trip (max value and live state in details).

design_system.rationale: Variables for chrome. The cursor ring uses rose with an ivory halo, visible on both dark and light canvas areas.

accessibility.rationale: The canvas is focusable with role=img, an aria-label and instructions via aria-describedby. Keyboard stamping works, and each stamp is announced through the status line.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: touch-action:none on the canvas only, and the cursor is repositioned on resize. 0px overflow at 360; sliders and buttons are 44px.

openQuestions.title: Verify the extended success path and the HDR visual on a build with CanvasToneMapping
openQuestions.detail: Chrome 153, the only build available here, reports toneMapping.mode 'standard' even with --enable-blink-features=CanvasToneMapping, so the honoured branch has not run. Re-verify on Chrome 160+/Canary with the flag, ideally on an HDR display: confirm the echo reads 'extended' and that the bottom ramp, sun and highlights exceed SDR white.

openQuestions.title: Check HDR PNG encoding once implemented
openQuestions.detail: When Chrome encodes extended canvases with PQ/HLG, the export readback should report a maximum above 1.0. Re-run on a supporting build and record the result.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls should be at least 44x44 CSS px on touch screens, and components should adapt to their container so nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons, selects, inputs and ranges have min-height 44px. Selects inside .field are width:100% after a measured 117px overflow at 360px caused by long option text. Every page was re-measured at 0px overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive.js runs: overflow=0 on every page/viewport; responsive-check desktop ok 1/1, mobile ok 1/1

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels. Announce discrete outcomes through polite status/log regions and keep rapidly changing values out of live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every control is a native button/select/input with a visible label. Outcomes go to role=status / role=log regions. High-frequency readouts (slider positions, meters) use aria-live=off and announce only on change of state.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible SVG interactive editor drag handles keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give drag handles a focusable button role and a name that mentions arrow keys, use setPointerCapture with touch-action:none on the handle only, and make arrow-key movement go through the same clamped move helper.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each SVG handle <g> is tabindex=0 role=button with an aria-label naming its segment and value pair and the arrow-key interaction. Pointer capture and touch-action:none are on the handles only. Arrow keys (Shift for fine steps) call the same clamped movePoint() as pointer drags.

guidanceConsulted.query: canvas HDR wide gamut color rendering
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: The guide covers the html-in-canvas origin trial and is gated behind an explicit opt-in.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception: no origin-trial opt-in was made (npx modern-web-guidance@latest set-allow-origin-trials not run). Canvas content is exposed with role=img plus aria-label and a text status/readback table carrying the same information.

summary: A product-style HDR highlight tool with real pixel inspection and a measured export round trip. It honestly reports clipping where the feature or encoder is missing.
